multiple selections in this contour list, you can quickly define the same top and bottom values for several

Rest Machining
Rest machining of rest material areas from a previous contour or pocket machining job. Requirements: The
top and bottom have been defined in the previous job in absolute mode. If the Contour Milling cycle is used
as the reference, only one contour may be included. The possible reference cycles are listed when you call
up a rest material cycle.
